spec.description:
TensorGrip H represents the HVAC and
insulation-grade spray contact adhesive line manufactured by Quin Global under
the TensorGrip brand. Engineered to provide fast, permanent bonding of acoustic
duct liners, fiberglass insulation, and building materials to sheet metal and
structural substrates, it features a self-contained portable canister system. It
withstands continuous high service temperatures in commercial ventilation
systems while significantly reducing labor time compared to traditional wet
adhesives.
features:
High-speed spray application from portable
canisters

High heat resistance suitable for commercial HVAC duct
environments
Immediate green strength and fast drying within 1 to 3 minutes
Formulated for superior adhesion to sheet metal, steel, and concrete

Clean,
uniform web spray pattern minimizes overspray and wastage

Zero compressor
setup required on job sites
Low VOC and non-chlorinated formulation options

technical.value:
500 ml aerosol, 22 L canister
(17 kg), 108 L canister

spec.fire:
Heat resistant up to 115°C; complies with standard commercial HVAC duct fire
requirements
spec.compliance:
Complies with AS 4254 for ductwork installation
when used with approved liners
spec.sustainability:
Low VOC formulations; zero
ODP; non-chlorinated options
install:
Ensure sheet metal duct surface is
thoroughly clean, dry, and free of oil or grease

Connect hose and spray gun
to the canister and fully open the valve

Spray adhesive evenly over both the
sheet metal and the insulation backing

Allow 1 to 3 minutes for adhesive to
become touch-dry with no transfer

Position insulation carefully and press
into place on the duct surface

Consolidate bond by rolling firmly with a hand
pressure roller across the entire surface
selection_checklist:
Confirm
substrate is sheet metal, steel, or concrete

Check operating temperature of
duct or plant room
Verify hose and spray gun accessories are on site
Ensure adequate ventilation during spray application
limitations:
Not recommended for standard EPS foam without verifying
compatibility
Ensure working area is well ventilated

Canisters must not be
stored below 10°C
spec.warranty: Backed by Quin Global manufacturer warranty

problem_keywords: securing acoustic liner in AC ducts
use_cases:
Fast bonding of acoustic ductliner to internal
sheet metal air conditioning ducts

Adhering thermal glasswool blankets around
mechanical equipment and pipe risers

Securing acoustic insulation inside air
handling units and plenums
not_for: Standard EPS foam boards without testing
retrieval.rag_summary:
Misc TensorgripH (TensorGrip H-Series by Quin Global) is a
portable canister spray contact adhesive formulated for HVAC duct lining,
acoustic insulation, and mechanical plant room installations. Designed to bond
glasswool, rockwool, and acoustic foams to sheet metal, concrete, and timber, it
offers fast tack, high heat resistance up to 115°C, and excellent bond strength.
The self-contained pressurized canister eliminates manual brushing and
compressed air lines, providing clean, rapid installation compliant with HVAC
ductwork standards.
